title: Automated Detection Of Enlarged Extraocular Muscle In Graves’ Ophthalmopathy With Computed Tomography And Deep Neural Network
summary: A specific clinical imaging result is tested against defined extraocular muscle enlargement in prospective cohort; supports narrow diagnostic validation. Do not infer care benefit. Research Square v1 date metadata not independently recovered; DOI history is later journal article 2022-09-22, so hold version date unresolved?
ai_technology: Journal primary source/paper: prospective observational CT study, 371 participants (199 Graves ophthalmopathy with enlarged extraocular muscles; 172 controls). Deep neural network trained/validated/tested on separated 222/74/75 images; test AUC .946, sensitivity 92.5%, specificity 88.6%. Clinical diagnostic finding is accurate CT identification under study criteria; not deployment/clinical benefit.
